crystal_phase: cubic SrTiO3 with a perovskite structure
evidence: The as-deposited films were amorphous, but crystallized after post-deposition anneal above 500°C. The diffraction peaks of the STO film point to the formation of cubic SrTiO3 with a perovskite structure, as is evident from the agreement with the (110), (111), (200), and (211) peaks of the SrTiO3 powder spectrum.
